Senses.Explanation: Poison is what a saying or medicine becomes when its reception harms rather than frees. Zhihai Benyi offers a phrase to chew and warns that failure to break it turns poisonous; Yongming Yanshou and other speakers say the finest clarified butter becomes poison in an unclean vessel. The bend is relational: offered material can cure or poison according to the encounter.
